camel_example: aliyun csas CreateVirusScanTask --region cn-hangzhou --MatchMode UserGroupNormal --MidRiskOperation Notify --ScanTargets.1 Virus --ScanMode Quick --TaskDescription '研发部门全盘扫描' --PerformanceMode Balance --HighRiskOperation Quarantine --LowRiskOperation None --method POST --force
description_en: Creates an instant virus scan task and delivers it to user endpoint devices within the effective scope. The task takes effect immediately after creation. A maximum of 10 tasks can be created per Alibaba Cloud account per minute
description_zh: 创建一个即时病毒扫描任务并下发到生效范围内的用户终端设备，创建成功后立即生效。同一阿里云账号1分钟内最多创建10个任务
kebab_example: aliyun csas create-virus-scan-task --task-description '研发部门全盘扫描' --scan-targets Virus --scan-mode Quick --performance-mode Balance --high-risk-operation Quarantine --mid-risk-operation Notify --low-risk-operation None --match-mode UserGroupNormal --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateVirusScanTask

parameters.help_en: The task description. The description can be up to 128 characters in length and can contain Chinese characters, uppercase and lowercase letters, digits, spaces, periods (.), commas (,), semicolons (;), forward slashes (/), at signs (@), hyphens (-), and underscores (_)
parameters.help_zh: 任务描述。长度不超过128个字符，支持中文、大小写英文字母、数字及空格、半角句点（.）、逗号（,）、分号（;）、正斜杠（/）、@、连字符（-）、下划线（_）
parameters.name: task_description

parameters.help_en: The collection of virus types to be handled in this scan. At least one type must be specified. Duplicate values are not allowed
parameters.help_zh: 本次扫描要处置的病毒类型集合，至少包含1个，不允许重复
parameters.name: scan_targets

parameters.help_en:
The scan path scope. Valid values:
Quick: quick scan. Only system critical directories and common risk locations are scanned.
Full: full disk scan.
Custom: custom path scan. ScanPath is required when this value is specified
parameters.help_zh:
扫描的路径范围。取值：
Quick：快速扫描，仅扫描系统关键目录与常见风险位置。
Full：全盘扫描。
Custom：自定义路径扫描，此时ScanPath必填
parameters.name: scan_mode

parameters.help_en: The collection of custom scan paths. This parameter is required when ScanMode is set to Custom and cannot be specified when ScanMode is set to Quick or Full. A maximum of 100 paths can be specified. Duplicate values are not allowed
parameters.help_zh: 自定义扫描路径集合。ScanMode取值为Custom时必填，取值为Quick或Full时不允许传入。最多包含100个，不允许重复
parameters.name: scan_path

parameters.help_en:
The scan performance pattern. Valid values:
SecurityFirst: security first. The default CPU usage limit is 50%.
Balance: balanced. The default CPU usage limit is 30%.
ExperienceFirst: experience first. The default CPU usage limit is 15%
parameters.help_zh:
扫描性能模式。取值：
SecurityFirst：安全优先，CPU占用上限默认为50%。
Balance：均衡，CPU占用上限默认为30%。
ExperienceFirst：体验优先，CPU占用上限默认为15%
parameters.name: performance_mode

parameters.help_en:
The action to take on high-risk virus files. Valid values:
Quarantine: quarantine quarantined file.
Notify: report an alert only without taking action on quarantined file
parameters.help_zh:
对高危病毒文件的处置动作。取值：
Quarantine：隔离文件。
Notify：仅上报告警，不处置文件
parameters.name: high_risk_operation

parameters.help_en:
The action to take on medium-risk virus files. Valid values:
Quarantine: quarantine quarantined file.
Notify: report an alert only without taking action on quarantined file
parameters.help_zh:
对中危病毒文件的处置动作。取值：
Quarantine：隔离文件。
Notify：仅上报告警，不处置文件
parameters.name: mid_risk_operation

parameters.help_en:
The action to take on low-risk virus files. Valid values:
Quarantine: quarantine quarantined file.
Notify: report an alert only without taking action on quarantined file.
None: take no action
parameters.help_zh:
对低危病毒文件的处置动作。取值：
Quarantine：隔离文件。
Notify：仅上报告警，不处置文件。
None：不处理
parameters.name: low_risk_operation

parameters.help_en:
The matching mode for the effective scope. Valid values:
UserGroupAll: applies to all users under the current Alibaba Cloud account.
UserGroupNormal: applies only to users in specified user groups. UserGroupIds is required when this value is specified
parameters.help_zh:
生效范围的匹配方式。取值：
UserGroupAll：对当前阿里云账号下的全部用户生效。
UserGroupNormal：仅对指定用户组内的用户生效，此时UserGroupIds必填
parameters.name: match_mode

parameters.help_en: The list of exempt users. Users in this list do not execute this scan task. A maximum of 1000 users can be specified. Duplicate values are not allowed
parameters.help_zh: 例外用户名单，名单内的用户不执行本次扫描。最多包含1000个，不允许重复
parameters.name: whitelist

parameters.help_en: The task expiration time, in seconds-level UNIX timestamp. After this time, endpoints no longer pull and execute this task. If this parameter is not specified or the specified time is earlier than the current time, the value defaults to the current time plus 24 hours
parameters.help_zh: 任务失效时间，秒级Unix时间戳。超过该时间后终端不再拉取执行本任务。不传或传入的时间早于当前时间时，取当前时间加24小时
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: The collection of user group IDs to which the task applies. This parameter is required when MatchMode is set to UserGroupNormal and cannot be specified when MatchMode is set to UserGroupAll. At least 1 and at most 100 IDs can be specified. Duplicate values are not allowed
parameters.help_zh: 生效的用户组ID集合。MatchMode取值为UserGroupNormal时必填，取值为UserGroupAll时不允许传入。传入时至少包含1个，最多包含100个，不允许重复
parameters.name: user_group_ids

parameters.help_en: The maximum percentage of endpoint CPU usage during scanning. Valid values: 0 to 100. If this parameter is not specified or is set to 0, the default value is determined by PerformanceMode: 50 for SecurityFirst, 30 for Balance, and 15 for ExperienceFirst
parameters.help_zh: 扫描时占用终端CPU的百分比上限。取值范围：0~100。不传或传0时，按PerformanceMode取默认值：SecurityFirst为50，Balance为30，ExperienceFirst为15
parameters.name: max_cpu_usage

TaskId.description_en: The ID of the created virus scan task
